title: Write the shooter commands
summary: Write shoot() with startEnd and simulateBallLaunch() with runOnce.

say.never: Hold down **Ctrl** and tap **P**. A small search box pops up at the top. Type `ShooterCommands`, then press **Enter**. It finds any file by its name, so you never have to dig through folders.
say.bit: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `ShooterCommands` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

say.never: Below the comment that describes it. Click in the code, then hold **Ctrl** and tap **F** to open the search box. Type `Command shoot` and press **Enter**. The editor scrolls to the right spot and highlights it.
say.bit: Below the comment that describes it. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `Command shoot` and press Enter to jump to it.

say.never: Your turn! Write `shoot()` first using `Commands.startEnd`, the way the board showed. Then write `simulateBallLaunch()` using `Commands.runOnce`, which runs its note one time and finishes.
